title: DeFi total value locked reaches new milestone despite market
content:
TL;DR: While DeFi's Total Value Locked (TVL) recently hit a new numerical milestone, for serious transactors, the immutable security of the Bitcoin network remains the paramount metric for true digital sovereignty. With a current hashrate of 916.25 EH/s and difficulty adjustment 84.0% complete, Bitcoin continues its relentless march as the hardest money, demonstrating unwavering global commitment to a decentralized monetary base. This resilience underscores Bitcoin's foundational role against the backdrop of volatile, often re-hypothecated, DeFi ecosystems, urging a focus on self-custody and the protocol's unyielding fundamentals.
